                                              Robust standard features, all-electric, and built with a Heart of Joy.

                                              With a range of 383-434 miles and a starting MSRP of $61,500, the BMW iX3 50 xDrive sets new standards for all-electric SUVs. The innovative BMW Heart of Joy integrates drivetrain, braking, and recuperation into one single system. Paired with BMW’s Dynamic Performance Control system, this makes for the most responsive, efficient, and precise BMW driving experience yet. The incredibly modern iX3 experience continues with new BMW Panoramic Vision, which projects key content directly on the lower section of the windshield.

                                              Estimated ranges attainable when battery fully charged & under ideal driving conditions. Actual range will vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to: vehicle model, tire & wheel selections, driving style, accessories used, traffic conditions, outside temperatures, & charging frequency.                                               The distinct front silhouette of the iX3 is defined by precise, minimalist lines, accentuated by the available BMW Iconic Glow Kidney Grille. Automatic door handles blend in seamlessly, complementing the elegant design.

                                              Clear surfaces and precise lines create a striking and aerodynamic silhouette. Powerfully contoured shoulders accentuate the elegant rear lights that frame the new BMW badge.

                                              iX3 50 xDrive

                                              Ocean Wave Blue Metallic

                                              Discover more colors
                                              More exterior highlights

                                              Automatically extending door handles.

                                              Virtually invisible door handles sit flush with the body of the BMW iX3, which immediately detects your approach if you have your BMW Digital Key Plus on your smartphone or smartwatch. At a distance of approximately six feet, the door handles extend and light up in darkness.

                                              Always ready for adventure, even if you don’t pack light.

                                              Mount the available BMW roof rack on the available roof rails in your iX3 roof. A separately available roof box and other BMW accessories also offer additional storage space.

                                              Available roof rack and roof rails shown.

                                              The power of simplicity.

                                              The intelligent charging flap simplifies your vehicle’s recharging, opening automatically as soon as the iX3 detects your intent to charge. During the charging process, the flap closes slightly to protect the plug against inclement weather. Once the plug is removed, the charging flap closes automatically.

                                              The first BMW Panoramic iDrive.

                                              The new BMW Panoramic iDrive display and control system combines four central elements for a unique driver experience. Interact via intuitive touch or voice with the BMW Intelligent Personal Assistant, and always have information in the right place at the right time so you can keep your eyes on the road and hands on the wheel.

                                              BMW iX3 named the 2026 World Car of the Year and World Electric Vehicle.

                                              An international jury of motoring journalists agree: the first New Era BMW is the ultimate title winner at the prestigious World Car Awards.

                                              0:00
                                              0:00 /  0:00
                                              BMW Panoramic iDrive with BMW Operating System X.
                                              A display as smart as your phone.

                                              The high-resolution Central Display, featuring a Free-Cut Design, is conveniently located next to the steering wheel for easy access. It allows for intuitive navigation through entertainment, communication, and navigation functions. Simply drag and drop your favorite widgets into the BMW Panoramic Vision.

                                              BMW Panoramic Vision: a new approach to visual information.

                                              The all-new BMW Panoramic Vision offers individually configurable content that spans almost the entire width of the front windshield. You can customize widgets for navigation, music, weather, and more, ensuring they are clearly visible to all passengers throughout the journey.

                                              Control that exceeds expectations.

                                              The Shy Tech operating elements on your BMW multifunction steering wheel are only visible when available. A relief-style surface responds to touch and provides tactile feedback, allowing you to manage key functions without diverting your attention from the road.

                                              You’re in control.

                                              The available BMW 3D Head-up Display provides you with accurate, real-time 3D views of essential driving information. With the assistance systems activated, you benefit from seamlessly integrated navigation and driver assistance intelligently presented.

                                              Just say, “Hey BMW.”

                                              Meet the BMW Intelligent Personal Assistant, your sophisticated co-driver who is continuously learning based on your prompts. It offers easy access to features like navigation, communication, entertainment, and vehicle controls. While you drive, it can proactively offer suggestions and even handle repetitive tasks, if you choose to do so. This personal assistant stays up to date automatically.

                                              Smart integration for smarter control.

                                              The My BMW App connects you directly to your iX3. It provides precise, real-time information on your vehicle status and charging, and also allows you to remotely control various functions form your smartphone, such as vehicle locking, lights, and windows. While on the move, all passengers can individually control their air conditioning, media, and other settings via the app.

                                              Start gaming, streaming, or meeting with a Digital Premium subscription.

                                              During breaks from driving, stream films and series from providers like Disney+, or enjoy games from Hot Wheels: Xtreme Overdrive, all on your Central Display. You can participate in phone conferences using the fully integrated Zoom app, and even use the Zoom video function when your BMW iX3 is parked. A wider and ever-growing selection of apps continues to be offered.

                                              Remote updates, elevating upgrades.

                                              Remote software updates ensure your BMW operates seamlessly, providing you with new features and quality enhancements at no extra cost. The BMW ConnectedDrive Store offers optional upgrades to enhance and personalize your driving experience even more. You can access driver assistance systems, safety features, and expanded navigation and entertainment options for your BMW.

                                              Designed with every drive in mind.

                                              Standard Driving Assistant Plus brings a suite of comprehensive safety features, including Distance Control, Steering Assistant, Active Blind Spot Detection, and Active Park Distance Control with Side Protection.

                                               

                                              Video shows computer-generated content and concept vehicle.

                                              Highway Assistant.

                                              The available Highway & Commuting Assistant enables attentive hands-free driving at speeds up to 85 mph where conditions and speed limits allow. This partially automated driving function also includes Active Lane Change, when the driver can confirm suggested lane changes simply by looking in the corresponding exterior side mirror.

                                              Driver assistance features are not a substitute for the driver’s responsibility to operate the vehicle in a safe manner. Always pay attention to traffic, surroundings, and road conditions while using Highway Assistant. Weather, traffic, road conditions, cellular service and map data may affect performance of driver assistance features. The Highway Assistant is not available in Alaska, Puerto Rico or Hawaii. Please refer to your owner’s manual or your BMW Center for more information.

                                              Video shows computer-generated content and concept vehicle.

                                              Driving Assistant Plus.

                                              The standard Driving Assistant Plus package provides support for steering and braking. The Distance Control feature permanently maintains desired speed and distance from the vehicle in front, and brakes your BMW if needed. Steering Assistant also keeps your BMW in the middle of the lane.

                                               

                                              Image shows computer-generated content and concept vehicle.

                                              Parking Assistant Plus and Parking Assistant Professional.

                                              Park effortlessly with the available Parking Assistant Plus, which provides enhanced parking views. You can also save repeated maneuvers, such as parking in your home driveway, and execute them automatically at any time. Parking Assistant Professional integrates with the My BMW App, letting you perform these actions remotely from your smartphone while outside the vehicle. 

                                               

                                              Image shows computer-generated content and concept vehicle.

                                              BMW Symbiotic Drive: seamless support comes standard.

                                              BMW Symbiotic Drive is a new level of driver assistance. AI-supported software uses cutting-edge sensors, software, and processors to integrate with the driver’s commands, supporting features like cooperative steering and braking, and much more.

                                              The collision avoidance and emergencies features include features like Forward Collision Mitigation, Evasion Assistant and Active Park Distance Control with Side Protection.

                                              Lane tracking and lane changing features include Steering Assistant, Active Blind Spot Detection, and Lane Keeping Assistant.

                                              Distance Control lets you set your desired cruising speed and following distance from the vehicle ahead.

                                              Parking Assistance includes, among other features, Automated Park Assistant, Parking View with 3D View and Panorama View, Park Distance Control, and Back Up Assistant.

                                              Get Speed Limit Assistant, Speed Limit Info, and Traffic Jam Assistant.

                                              A holistic experience for your senses.

                                              The carefully crafted interior of the BMW iX3 is inviting and inspiring, with a driver-oriented design that is both elegant and highly functional. Materials, colors, sound, and light combine harmoniously to maximize driving comfort and enjoyment.

                                              iX3 50 xDrive

                                              Digital White Contemporary

                                              Discover more colors

                                              Contemporary interior design | Bicolour Digital White

                                              Crisp and minimalist, Bicolour Digital White creates an inviting yet distinctly contemporary space. The illuminated instrument panel is a particular highlight. (available as an option)

                                              Essential interior design | Vivid Grey Bicolour

                                              This harmonious combination of grey tones exudes a warm and natural feel. The Econeer seat cover offers a comfortable woven surface.

                                              The warm tones of Bicolour Castanea evoke a sense of cocooning comfort in the interior. (available as an option)

                                              Space where you need it.

                                              The iX3’s generous trunk capacity means you can pack what you need, when you need it. Additional storage in the frunk allows for easy charging cable storage and access.

                                              A combination of light and space.

                                              The available large Panoramic glass sunroof lets light flood into your BMW, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. Tinted climate comfort glass also prevents the interior from overheating on warm summer days, with multi-layered design absorbing sunlight and providing protection from UV and infrared rays. An available sun shade may also be purchased from your BMW Center.

                                              Great comfort, all-round.

                                              The iX3’s generous interior design and bespoke electric vehicle architecture ensures rear passengers get plenty of space to stretch. Backrests can be angled anywhere from 23 to 31 degrees, letting you prioritize seating or storage, whichever you need most. When packing long or bulky objects, fold down seats individually for a 40/20/40 split.

                                              Personalized settings for individual comfort.

                                              Optional Multi-Functional Seats allow adjustment for backrest width, lumbar support, and more, delivering a truly personal fit. A seven-program massage function also offers ultimate comfort and relaxation. The integrated Travel & Comfort System lets you attach mobile devices and accessories to the back of the seats for entertainment on the go.

                                              Engineered today, for the driving dynamics of tomorrow.

                                              The 2027 BMW iX3 is the first vehicle to integrate control of the drive system and control of driving dynamics into one single unit, appropriately named the BMW Heart of Joy. This central computer works alongside BMW Dynamic Performance Control Software to coordinate every process in milliseconds, ensuring exceptional control and confidence-inspiring driving, including a revolutionary Soft Stop function.

                                              A new benchmark in efficiency.

                                              With BMW EfficientDynamics, lower energy consumption and a larger electric range are top priority. In the iX3, comprehensive optimized systems include new sixth-generation 800-volt drive and battery technology.

                                              Electric drive, intelligent control.

                                              The BMW iX3 is powered by two specially designed 800V electric motors that feature sixth-generation eDrive technology. Positioned at the front and rear axles, these motors engage during accelerating and braking, precisely delivering the necessary power based on driving conditions. This intelligent all-wheel drive system enables dynamic, efficient driving, even on challenging terrain.

                                              Innovative battery technology.

                                              With system voltage of 800V, energy-dense lithium-ion round cells and innovative integration, the sixth-generation batteries offer increased energy storage and rapid charging capabilities. Thanks to the chassis architecture, these batteries are securely and compactly installed in the vehicle’s underbody.

                                              Actual range will vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to: vehicle model, tire and wheel selection, driving style, traffic conditions, battery charge level when charging begins and outside temperature.

                                              The BMW iX3 combines familiar SUV proportions with low aerodynamic drag, boosting efficiency while retaining all the space and comfort you expect.

                                              If desired, the BMW iX3 can calculate the most efficient route for your journey, including charging stops. It considers factors such as charging prices and personal preferences such as charge point operators.

                                              The BMW iX3 supports bidirectional charging. This allows it to act as energy storage for backup power at home or as a power bank while on the road.

                                              Drive farther. Charge faster. That’s true freedom.

                                              The BMW iX3 is an all-electric SUV that offers impressive range, allowing you to drive 383-434 miles on a full battery.

                                               

                                              Enjoy convenient, ultra-rapid charging within the BMW Charging Network. The iX3's NACS charge port allows for seamless access to Tesla Superchargers—part of the BMW Charging Network. And thanks to the included CCS (Level 3) adapter, you can charge nearly anywhere.

                                               

                                              Use the battery of the BMW iX3 as battery storage for bidirectional charging in various ways. Whether to supply your home with back-up electricity, or to use your vehicle as a mobile power bank to power consumer electronics or power source to charge another BMW.

                                              Charge at 180,000+ charging points across our North American provider network.

                                              BMW Charging boasts one of the largest public charging networks in North America, now including Tesla Superchargers—so you can go the distance without hesitation. And as a BMW driver, you’ll enjoy the convenient Plug & Charge feature for instant authentication at IONNA, and Tesla Supercharger stations.

                                              A charging experience like no other.

                                              Experience the future of convenience at IONNA's thoughtfully equipped stations. With premium amenities at many locations—including Rechargery Markets, cafes, and driver's lounges—every stop provides the opportunity to relax and recharge. And as a BMW driver, you'll enjoy preferential pricing on all charging sessions.

                                              Until September 30, 2026, BMW drivers who start a charge with Plug & Charge or the My BMW App at IONNA will automatically receive 20% off their charging sessions. After that, BMW drivers will continue to enjoy an ongoing 10% discount every time they charge. Customer must create a Shell Recharge account in the My BMW App or Plug & Charge in order to receive the discount. Discounts will not be applied if customers use a credit card at the station.

                                              Experience IONNA

                                              Access it all with the My BMW App.

                                              All BMW ChargingNetwork providers are seamlessly integrated in the My BMW App, creating one of the largest public charging networks in North America. Simply enroll with Electrify America and Shell Recharge in the app and you'll have easy access to the entire network including Electrify America, Shell Recharge, IONNA, Tesla Superchargers, EVgo, ChargePoint, and more.

                                              Charge from the comfort of home.

                                              Wake up to a full charge in the morning with the Multi-Function Charger. Every all-electric BMW comes equipped with this versatile charger that's compatible with any 120V household outlet and 240V outlet (adapters included).

                                              Or for the ultimate convenience, install the available BMW Wallbox Plus—our NACS Level 2 charger that installs in your garage or outdoors for faster charging whenever you need it. Simply enroll using your BMW ID in the MyBMW App.

                                              Digital products and services interface directly with your BMW via BMW ConnectedDrive. Communicate even more intuitively and enjoy intelligent, innovative features for greater safety, comfort, and entertainment.

                                              Frequently asked questions about the BMW iX3.

                                              The BMW iX3 won the 2026 World Car of the Year™ and 2026 World Electric Vehicle because judges recognized it as the strongest overall new vehicle, combining innovative design, electric vehicle technology, driving performance, user experience, and overall value.

                                               

                                              Chosen by a jury of 98 international automotive journalists from 33 countries from an initial field of 58 contenders, the iX3 stood out as the first production model of BMW's New Era. It introduces a new design language, longer range, faster charging (800-volt system capable of up to 400 kW rapid charging), next-generation driver assistance systems, the BMW Panoramic iDrive, and the new Heart of Joy driving control system.

                                               

                                              This marks BMW's 11th World Car Award win in the program's 22-year history.

                                              The Neue Klasse 2027 BMW iX3 50 xDrive arrives to the United States in 2026. Reservations begin in early May, with deliveries starting in fall 2026.

                                              The BMW iX3 50 xDrive has an electric range of 383-434 miles.

                                              The 2027 BMW iX3 50 xDrive features an 800-volt battery and up to 400 kW DC charging, which can take you from 10-80% in just 21 minutes.

                                               

                                              Time displayed assumes vehicle charges at its maximum charge rate.

                                              Through the BMW ChargingNetwork, you'll have access to an ever-growing nationwide network of public charging points, including DC Fast Charging stations from top providers. Thanks to the NACS charge port of the BMW iX3, you can seamlessly charge at Tesla Superchargers, which are part of the BMW ChargingNetwork. The adapter for charging at a CCS charger is included with your BMW iX3. You can view charging locations in your vehicle's navigation system or through the My BMW App. To learn more, visit the BMW ChargingNetwork page.

                                              The BMW iX3 features a high-voltage lithium-ion battery with a total capacity of 112.3 kWh. This battery has a warranty of 8 years / 100,000 miles. The lifespan of your battery can be extended by practicing a moderate driving style, good charging habits, and avoiding severe conditions.

                                               

                                              BMW of North America, LLC (BMW NA) warrants the high-voltage lithium-ion battery assembly against defects in materials or workmanship for a period of 8 years / 100,000 miles, whichever occurs first. This coverage is in addition to the high-voltage lithium-ion battery's limited warranty for defects in materials or workmanship. Due to its inherent technical design, the high-voltage lithium-ion battery's capacity will decrease over time and with use.

                                              No, CCS (Combined Charging System) DC adapters are designed specifically for high-voltage DC fast charging and are incompatible with AC charging equipment. AC adapters to charge at Level 2 charging stations are available for purchase from your BMW dealer. 

                                              You can charge the BMW iX3 at home or at a public charger. The BMW iX3 comes with the Multifunctional Charger which plugs into a standard 120V household outlet or a 240V outlet (recommended). The optional BMW Wallbox can be installed at your home for 240V hardwired charging.  

                                               

                                              When it comes to public charging, the BMW ChargingNetwork makes things easy. The nation's top charging providers are seamlessly integrated in the vehicle navigation and the My BMW App and automatically included in your route planning should a charge stop be required. The 2027 BMW iX3 features an NACS charge port which means that you can also access the Tesla Supercharger network without the use of an adapter. To learn more, visit the BMW ChargingNetwork page.

                                              Yes, the BMW iX3 is a fully electric SUV, powered by an electric motor using BMW’s eDrive technology. The 2027 BMW iX3 is part of the Neue Klasse line of vehicles, with an unprecedented range and charging time capacity.

                                              The BMW iX3 50 xDrive features a 0-60 mph time of just 4.7 seconds.

                                               

                                              BMW AG preliminary test results. Actual acceleration results may vary, depending on specification of vehicle; road and environmental conditions; testing procedures and driving style. These results should be used for comparison only and verification should not be attempted on public roads. BMW urges you to obey all posted speed laws and always wear safety belts.

                                              The 2027 BMW iX3 50 xDrive comes standard with xDrive, BMW's intelligent all-wheel drive system, which provides superior traction and stability in harsh weather, and a more responsive driving feel.

                                              The BMW iX3 differs from the BMW X3 in many ways. The BMW iX3 is fully electric, while the X3 has a combustion engine, though the X3 is available in multiple models. The iX3 driving dynamics are smooth and quiet with instant EV torque, while the X3 has a traditional engine sound and feel. The iX3 vehicle is a zero-emission vehicle, while the X3 is available as a gasoline vehicle.

                                              The 2027 BMW iX3 50 xDrive has standard dual-motor all-wheel drive. It features 400 kW ultra-fast charging capability, a range of 383-434 miles, and a new minimalist interior with BMW Panoramic Vision display. It also features bidirectional charging, heated seats, and comfort access with BMW Digital Key Plus.

                                              The 2027 BMW iX3 is assembled at the BMW plant in Debrecen, Hungary. 

                                              The 2027 BMW iX3 50 xDrive is 188.3" in length, 74.6" in width, and 64.4" in height.

                                              The 2027 BMW iX3 comes standard with the Driving Assistant Plus package, which features Distance Control with Steering Assistant. This feature supports steering and braking by permanently maintaining desired speed and distance from the vehicle in front, and braking your BMW if needed. It also keeps your BMW in the middle of the lane throughout these active steering interventions. Available assistance features include Parking Assistant Plus and Parking Assistant Professional. Parking Assistant Plus provides enhanced parking views and allows you to save repeated maneuvers. Parking Assistant Professional integrates with the My BMW App, which lets you perform these actions remotely from your smartphone while outside the vehicle. The iX3 also has enhanced autonomous driving, augmented reality with the BMW Head-up Display, and the new BMW Panoramic Vision display, which integrates warnings across the windshield.

                                              Reserving a BMW iX3.

                                              The BMW iX3 Reservation Program gives BMW customers the chance to order their iX3 early and be among the first owners. By submitting your order, confirming your information, and paying a deposit, your production priority is secured.

                                              To secure your place among the first BMW iX3 owners, configure your iX3, submit your build to your local participating dealer, wait for your dealer to confirm your information, then pay the $1,000 deposit via the payment link you receive via Stripe.

                                              The deposit for the BMW iX3 reservation is $1,000 which is paid through Stripe and processed by your dealer.

                                              Yes, your deposit is refundable. It is the owner's responsibility to cancel their reservation.

                                              Deliveries of the BMW iX3 will start in fall 2026. Please keep in mind that delivery dates depend on the specific vehicle configuration and production timeline.

                                              Your reservation does not guarantee a set price for your vehicle. Please be aware that your dealer sets the actual price, which may differ from the manufacturer’s suggested retail price (“MSRP”). The MSRP does not include taxes, title, transportation, other options and other dealer fees and charges.

                                              Under the Reservation Program, after your order has been confirmed, you may either purchase, finance, or lease the vehicle from your dealer.

                                              If you cancel your BMW iX3 reservation, you lose your production priority, and the next customer in line moves up in priority. All cancellations are final. If you submit a new reservation, you do not reclaim your original priority.

                                              The information collected on the Reservation website during your Reservation Process will be shared with BMW NA and the Dealer you select in order for us to confirm and process your Reservation. The handling of this information is governed by the BMW NA Privacy Policy which is available at http://www.bmwusa.com/privacy/. Although you will be on a BMW NA website, you will provide your payment information for the reservation deposit directly to the Dealer through one of the payments methods the Dealer accepts. BMW NA never receives or holds your payment information. BMW NA is not responsible for any information you submit to the Dealer.

                                              For any questions regarding your BMW iX3 reservation, you should contact your local dealer through which your reservation was made or refer to the Terms. If you have additional questions regarding the Reservation Program, please contact BMW Customer Service at 1-800-831-1117.

                                              Through use of our reservation process, you'll be able to secure early production of your new iX3 in three simple steps:

                                               

                                              1. Build your iX3 here and submit your information to your selected BMW dealer.
                                              2. Your dealer will contact you to confirm your order.
                                              3. Pay a $1,000 deposit to the dealer through Stripe online.

                                               

                                              Reservations require a refundable deposit paid to the dealer, who completes the transaction. The consumer may cancel the reservation at any time. All applicable terms, conditions, and restrictions are outlined in the Terms. Deliveries of the BMW iX3 start in fall 2026.
